documentary_scope: SHA-256 byte and canonical-manifest integrity within supplied inputs
Cryptographically valid synthetic ECDSA P-256 signatures
Separate declared sender and receiver signatures
Three declared replica digest, rollback and common ancestry checks

Manufacturer-verifiable instrument identities and traceable independent reference
Externally authenticated calibrated physical clock, counters, challenges and timestamp proof
Authenticated custody holders and trusted certificate/public-key origins
Signed physically observed handoff and receipt evidence

Original same-path measurements with uncertainty calibration and physical alarm issuance/response
Independent review of original real-world evidence against approved physical criteria
